AI isn’t replacing workers, so stop freaking out, it’s renting them instead. 

Yeah… this is real.

There’s now a platform where AI agents can hire humans to do physical tasks like pick up packages, attend meetings, verify things in the real world.

Basically… you’re an API with legs.

In this video, we break down what this actually is, how it works, and why something like this even exists in the first place.

Says a lot about where the job market is heading.… are you signing up for this?
title: AI BOTS ARE NOW "RENTING HUMANS"!
